name: tier-list-studio
description: Local-first desktop app for creating polished tier lists.

scripts.dev: concurrently -k "vite --host 127.0.0.1" "wait-on tcp:5173 && corepack pnpm run build:electron && cross-env VITE_DEV_SERVER_URL=http://127.0.0.1:5173 electron ."
scripts.build: tsc --noEmit && vite build && corepack pnpm run build:electron
scripts.build:electron: node -e "fs.rmSync('dist/main',{recursive:true,force:true});fs.rmSync('dist/preload',{recursive:true,force:true})" && tsc --target ES2022 --module NodeNext --moduleResolution NodeNext --strict --skipLibCheck --esModuleInterop --types node --outDir dist --rootDir src src/main/index.ts && node scripts/copy-db-schema.mjs && esbuild src/preload/index.cts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --target=es2022 --outfile=dist/preload/index.cjs --external:electron
scripts.package:win: corepack pnpm run build && electron-builder --win nsis
scripts.package:mac:x64: corepack pnpm run build && electron-builder --mac dmg --x64
scripts.package:mac:arm64: corepack pnpm run build && electron-builder --mac dmg --arm64
scripts.package:linux: corepack pnpm run build && electron-builder --linux AppImage
